description: A Fragment implementation for displaying and managing a cryptocurrency watchlist in an Android application.

classes.name: WatchlistFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that handles the UI for displaying and managing a watchlist of cryptocurrencies.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for this fragment and returns the root view.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the UI components after the view has been created.

methods.name: setupRecyclerView
methods.description: Initializes the RecyclerView with an adapter to display the list of cryptocurrencies.

methods.name: observeUiState
methods.description: Observes the UI state from the ViewModel and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: setupRefresh
methods.description: Sets up the refresh functionality for the watchlist.

methods.name: setupAddButton
methods.description: Configures the action for the add button to show a dialog for adding items to the watchlist.

methods.name: showAddToWatchlistDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to allow the user to add a new item to their watchlist.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up the binding reference when the view is destroyed.
